name: Banaue Rice Terraces
description: A famous mountain landscape in Ifugao known for its centuries-old rice terraces carved into the hillsides.

name: Mayon Volcano
description: An iconic active volcano in Albay known for its nearly perfect cone shape and beautiful surrounding scenery.

name: Chocolate Hills
description: A natural attraction in Bohol made up of hundreds of cone-shaped hills that turn brown during the dry season.

name: Puerto Princesa Underground River
description: A protected underground river system in Palawan featuring limestone caves, rock formations, and rich natural scenery.

name: Kawasan Falls
description: A popular waterfall destination in Cebu known for its turquoise water, multiple waterfall levels, and canyoneering activities.
